value.rationale: One-complementability of the canonical symmetric hyperplane is a natural Banach-space geometric invariant. A complete all-weight classification, a sharp n=4 singular boundary and impossibility for n>=5 settle a structural dimension phenomenon, and the optimal projection norm has a finite exact evaluable formula for any specified profile. The result is not limited to an arbitrary numerical parameter slice or a routine restatement of an existing projection theorem.
